approvedBy: 用户确认（2026-11-18：选择接受开发依赖例外）
reason: npm audit high findings all trace to GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (picomatch <= 4.0.7 ReDoS). Registry has no fixed picomatch release; downgrading vitest to 3.1.4 still resolves picomatch 4.0.7. The affected packages are build/test devDependencies and are not copied into the runtime frontend image (nginx + dist only). Glob patterns are repository-controlled, not user input.
compensatingControls: The frontend runtime image copies only nginx config and built dist; node_modules and dev tooling are not shipped.
Application input does not pass user-controlled glob patterns into picomatch/vite/vitest.
Raw npm audit JSON and the nonzero audit exit code remain in backend/target/scan-logs/frontend-audit.json and frontend-audit.log.
The exception is explicit (--exceptions), must be approved and unexpired, and fails the gate if a new advisory or package is uncovered.
Re-run npm audit at least every 30 days and upgrade/replace the toolchain when a fixed picomatch version is published.

advisories.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
